mapper.select: SELECT application_id FROM auth_governance.application_catalog WHERE application_id=#{app} FOR SHARE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.capability_lifecycle WHERE application_id=#{app} AND state<>'ACTIVE' AND capability IN #{cap})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.capability_lifecycle WHERE application_id=#{app} AND state='RETIRED' AND capability IN #{cap})
SELECT application_id,capability,state,version,reason,changed_by,updated_at FROM auth_governance.capability_lifecycle WHERE application_id=#{app} AND capability=#{cap}

choose.otherwise: UPDATE auth_governance.capability_lifecycle SET state=#{v.state},version=#{v.version},reason=#{v.reason},changed_by=#{v.changedBy},updated_at=#{v.updatedAt} WHERE application_id=#{v.applicationId} AND capability=#{v.capability} AND version=#{before}

mapper.select: SELECT application_id,command_id,payload_hash,capability,before_state,after_state,before_version,after_version,reason,actor,created_at FROM auth_governance.capability_lifecycle_command WHERE application_id=#{app} AND command_id=#{command}
